description: Maps qwentts.cpp P00-T05 anchor stage names to Candle P03-T01 stage names. Only stages with a verified structural equivalent in the Candle 723-stage manifest are mapped. Unmapped stages have no Candle structural equivalent and are excluded from the anchor Gate.

unmapped.codes-full_0000: Final code matrix; Candle emits talker_final_code_matrix via legacy hook (C layout), not a structured stage in the 723-stage manifest
unmapped.codes-step0_0001: First-frame code vector; no structured Candle equivalent in the 723-stage manifest
unmapped.output-audio_0003: Final PCM after vocoder; Candle emits codec_final_pcm via legacy hook, not a structured stage in the 723-stage manifest
unmapped.prompt-ids_0004: Input prompt token IDs; not captured as a numerical stage in Candle
unmapped.trailing-text-hidden_0014: Trailing text hidden state; not captured as a standalone stage in Candle
unmapped.tts-pad-embed_0015: TTS pad embedding; not captured as a standalone stage in Candle
